subject: Trial kickoff: scope confirmation and sprint plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Turner <evan@quantumwin.com>, Rachel Li <rachel.li@quantumwin.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Trial kickoff scope & proposed sprint plan

Hi Evan / Rachel —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a light-weight plan so we can get the trial moving this week. Please confirm the bits in bold and any changes to timelines below.

Key objectives (what success looks like):
- Validate end-to-end latency on your representative request mix: 95th percentile < 300ms for typical prompts.
- Verify integration path (API keys, VPC routing) and KV/prefix caching for your conversational flows.
- Surface any functional regressions against your evaluation set (precision/recall on NER tasks) with baseline scoring.

Proposed 3-week sprint (target start: Nov 15):
Week 0 (pre-kickoff, this week) — access + baseline data
- QuantumWin provides sample dataset (5k records) and a short prompt set.
- Network checklist completed by your infra team (see attached network-checklist.xlsx).
Week 1 — integration & smoke tests
- API integration, basic end-to-end smoke tests, prefix caching verification.
Week 2 — load/latency testing & quality evals
- Throughput and latency profiling, regression tests against eval set.
Week 3 — joint review & next-steps
- Review results, runway for pilot vs production recommendations.

Ownership (initial):
- Customer infra / network: QuantumWin (please confirm lead).
- Redwood infra / serving config: Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng).
- Integration + API wiring: Aditya Rao (Solutions/Pre-sales).
- Success criteria + eval scoring: Kimberly Park / Marissa Cole (Customer Success).
- Procurement / purchase order support: Rachel Li (I understand Rachel is your procurement contact, cc'd).

Asks for this week (to unblock start):
1) Evan — confirm the sample dataset drop-in (S3 link or shared Drive) and who on your team will run the network checklist.
2) Rachel — confirm procurement timeline / PO cadence so we can flag any gating items early.
3) Aditya / Marcus — can you confirm estimated time to spin up the trial cluster (dev config) given the proposed start date Nov 15?

Attachments: trial-scope-v1.pdf (scope & eval plan), network-checklist.xlsx (network/IP allowlist, proxy, egress).

If we can get confirmations by EOD Thursday (Nov 12), we'll lock the kickoff and I will send a calendar invite for a 60-min kickoff on Nov 16.

Thanks — looking forward to getting QuantumWin running.

--
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

Subject: Re: Recap: Trial kickoff scope & proposed sprint plan

Kimberly — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick notes: 

- We can provide the sample dataset by EOD Thursday (I'll drop an S3 link).
- Rachel is our procurement lead and will confirm the purchase order timeline — Rachel, can you confirm if we need a formal SOW first or if PO + acceptance testing is sufficient?
- Security: our InfoSec team will need to run a short questionnaire (SOC2 / data handling) — do you have a standard security checklist you can share?

We're available for a 60-minute kickoff on Nov 16 (morning PT preferred). If InfoSec needs a parallel session, we can schedule that Nov 13.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Turner
Director of ML Engineering | QuantumWin
evan@quantumwin.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

Subject: Internal: RACI & immediate actions for QuantumWin trial (Nov 15 start)

Team —

Summarizing internal commitments and proposed RACI for the QuantumWin trial. Evan confirmed dataset delivery by EOD Thu and a kickoff slot on Nov 16; we should be ready to start the integration work the week of Nov 15.

Proposed RACI (concise):
- Responsible (R) = does the work; Accountable (A) = signs off; Consulted (C) = advises; Informed (I) = kept in loop.

1) Infra & trial serving config
- R: Marcus Lin (Solutions Eng) — set up trial cluster, apply quantization profile, enable prefix cache.
- A: Marcus Lin
- C: Aditya Rao
- I: Kimberly Park, Marissa Cole

2) API integration & key exchange
- R: Aditya Rao — provide integration snippets, SDK examples, and route testing.
- A: Aditya Rao
- C: Marcus Lin
- I: Kimberly Park, Marissa Cole

3) Security & compliance intake (customer questionnaire)
- R: Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — collect answers and route to Redwood Security if needed.
- A: Marissa Cole
- C: Marcus Lin (for networking), Aditya Rao (for integration posture)
- I: Kimberly Park

4) Success metrics & evaluation scoring
- R: Kimberly Park / Marissa Cole — define pass/fail thresholds, own post-trial recommendations.
- A: Kimberly Park
- C: Aditya Rao, Marcus Lin
- I: EVP Sales (if any escalation)

Immediate next steps (please ack by EOD today):
- Marcus: provide estimate to provision trial cluster and any IP allowlist requirements (ETA: Nov 12 COB).
- Aditya: draft the integration example repo and a Postman collection (ETA: Nov 13 noon).
- Marissa: pull together Redwood's security questionnaire template and a short answers draft (ETA: Nov 13 afternoon).
- Kimberly: I will schedule the Nov 16 kickoff (60m) and prepare the evaluation workbook.

Attachments referenced to customer (for visibility): trial-scope-v1.pdf, network-checklist.xlsx. I also added the trial HubSpot record to related_links.

If you see any gaps in the RACI above, call them out now.

Thanks —
Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Internal: RACI & immediate actions for QuantumWin trial (Nov 15 start)

Kim / team — ack and short update: 

- I will provision the trial cluster in our dev pool and share credentials with Aditya by EOD Nov 12. Estimated time to provision and smoke-test: ~6 hours.
- Network allowlist: I need QuantumWin's outbound IP ranges and the S3 endpoint they will use (Evan said S3 link drop). Once we have that I will complete network-checklist.xlsx and send to Evan.
- Quantization/serving profile: I'll start with the 'conversational-medium' profile and tune if we see latency regressions during Week 2.
